patches.name: 0001-hw-xtensa-esp32s3_clk-ESP32-S3-clock-tree-with-qdev-.patch
patches.behavior: SYSTEM clock device becomes the register-level source of truth: five qdev Clock outputs (cpu-clk/apb-clk/xtal-clk/rtc-slow-clk/rtc-fast-clk) recomputed from SYSCLK_CONF/CPU_PER_CONF per TRM v1.8 ch.7 Tables 7.2-1..7.2-4; SYSCLK_CONF/CPU_PER_CONF R/W (documented fields, CLK_XTAL_FREQ RO); reset default TRM Register 17.20 (SOC_CLK_SEL=0 XTAL, PRE_DIV_CNT=1 -> CPU/APB 20 MHz; ROM reconfigures the PLL); PERIP_CLK_EN0/1 stored R/W with IDF6.1 field defaults (EN0=0x6181A06F, EN1=0x600), gate aggregations on named outputs; PERIP_RST_EN0/1 rising edges emit per-device reset strobes
patches.sha256: see qemu-extensions/prototypes/coreclk/ evidence section of the README

patches.name: 0002-hw-misc-esp32s3_rtc_cntl-S3-RTC-clock-tables-and-XTA.patch
patches.behavior: RTC_SLOW 136 kHz/32768/RC_FAST_DIV and RTC_FAST XTAL/2|RC_FAST 17.5 MHz per TRM ch.7 7.2.4.4 + ch.10 + IDF6.1 (replaces the old C3-style 150 kHz / xtal/4|8 MHz tables); xtal-clk input refreshes derived rates without pulsing clk_update (no reset-callback recursion); RTC-domain-gated hold (RTC_TIME base survives CPU-only resets); FAST_CLK_RTC_SEL reset default 0 honored

patches.name: 0003-hw-timer-live-clock-inputs-for-TIMG-and-SYSTIMER.patch
patches.behavior: TIMG time-base counters consume apb-clk/xtal-clk (USE_XTAL source select, TRM ch.12) plus PERIP_CLK_EN0 gate levels (timers=TIMERS&group, MWDT=WDG&group); counter advanced at the old rate before applying a new rate (tick state survives changes); gated groups freeze and resume with the remaining ticks; zero-rate guards replace a latent divide-by-zero; XTAL32K calibration constant 32000->32768. SYSTIMER consumes xtal-clk, CNT_CLK=2/5*XTAL=16 MHz, invariant to CPU/APB dividers (TRM ch.11); muldiv64 tick conversion; SYSTIMER_CLK_EN deliberately NOT a counter gate (APB register-access gate only). Both carry the soc-reset domain link

patches.name: 0004-hw-gate-digital-peripheral-holds-by-the-ESP32-S3-res.patch
patches.behavior: GDMA/intmatrix/UART/SPI1/TWAI/AES/SHA/RSA/HMAC/DS holds skip their clearing when the pending reset is CPU-only (soc-reset link, esp32s3_reset_covers_periph); fixes the pre-existing blanket-reset leak that wiped guest-visible PERIPH state on every reset request; machines without the link keep prior behavior

patches.name: 0005-hw-xtensa-esp32s3-propagate-the-clock-tree-and-reset.patch
patches.behavior: esp32s3_clk_update propagates the full tree (no reset-callback recursion); pre-realize wiring: cpu cores <- cpu-clk, TIMG0/1 apb/xtal + gate lines, SYSTIMER xtal, RTC_CNTL xtal, soc-reset links; esp32s3_soc_reset PERIPH domain cold-resets SYSTEM/intmatrix/UARTx3/TIMGx2/SYSTIMER/GDMA/SPI1/SDMMC/TWAI/AES/SHA/RSA/HMAC/DS/XTS/RNG/GPIO/PMS, RTC domain cold-resets RTC_CNTL (eFuse/USB-JTAG/RGB excluded, commented); pending reset domain latched until the next request or a PERIP_RST strobe

patches.name: 0006-tests-qtest-ESP32-S3-clock-tree-and-reset-domain-tes.patch
patches.behavior: 9-case qtest suite (see README): reset clock state + XTAL via TIMG calibration, divider/source register semantics, APB switch altering TIMG progress, TIMG XTAL source + prescaler, SYSTIMER CNT_CLK invariance, PERIP_CLK_EN0 gate halt/resume, SW system reset clearing PERIPH while RTC survives, SW PROCPU/APPCPU resets preserving PERIPH, PERIP_RST strobes

patches.name: 0007-hw-xtensa-esp32s3-TEMPORARY-I2C_MST-BBPLL-cal-done-b.patch
patches.behavior: SUPERSEDED-BY-REGI2C: read-only 4 KiB window at 0x6000E000 answering I2C_MST 0x6000E040 bit24 (I2C_BBPLL_CAL_DONE)=1. Evidence: with the real clock semantics an ordinary IDF 6.1 boot reaches rtc_clk_bbpll_configure (recalib_bbpll) and polls that bit exactly once per boot (warn-probe: 1 hit/run); without the window the boot spins there forever. DROP at integration when the REGI2C lane model owns 0x6000E000 - the two collide on the same window

patches.name: 0008-hw-timer-esp_timg-hardware-divider-field-encoding-and-exact.patch
patches.behavior: TIMG_Tx_DIVIDER hardware encoding per TRM v1.8 Register 12.1 + ch.12 + IDF6.1 esp_hal_timg esp32s3 timer_ll_set_clock_prescale: field 0 = divide by 65536 (was frozen zero-frequency), field 1 (reset value) = divide by 2 per TRM ch.12 12.2.1 the actual divisor is 2 (write path can never wedge or divide by zero), 2..65535 unchanged; counter/alarm conversions exact via muldiv64 (sub-MHz time bases and alarm delays); additive qtest timg-divider-boundary (fields 0/1/2 + alarm through max divider)
patches.sha256_note: 0008 patch sha256 efb0abff632616d3944e86cdcc86a8cfa5b555f61edd6425a649c6cd69632869 (amended after subagent review caught the field-1 divisor)

patches.name: 0009-hw-timer-esp_timg-exact-rational-tick-conversion.patch
patches.behavior: Exact rational tick conversion: ESPVirtualCounter keeps gcd-reduced rate_num/rate_den per ns (prescale folded: field 0 -> 65536, field 1 -> 2 per TRM 12.2.1) plus a sub-tick carry, so APB/65536 = 1220.703125 Hz counts 12207 ticks in 10 s (integer-Hz truncation gave 12200); alarm deadlines use the inverse exact split (12207-tick deadline 9.9999744 s asserted not-yet/fired); gated groups rate_num=0 stay frozen

patches.name: 0010-hw-xtensa-esp32s3_clk-common-clock-ports-for-SPI2-3.patch
patches.behavior: Centralized common clock ports for the peripheral overlay lanes: new Clock outputs pll-f80m-clk (80 MHz under PLL, PLL480/6 or PLL320/4), pll-f160m-clk (constant 160 MHz under PLL), pll-f240m-clk (240 MHz, 480 MHz PLL only, else 0), rc-fast-clk (standalone RC_FAST oscillator 17.5 MHz, validity from RTC_CNTL CK8M_FORCE_PD/PU [25/26] — independent of the RTC_FAST mux); PERIP_CLK_EN gate levels + PERIP_RST strobe AND new periph-rst-level bundle extended to SPI2[6]/SPI3[16]/I2C_EXT0[7]/I2C_EXT1[18]/RMT[9]/I2S0[4]/I2S1[21]/UART[2]/UART1[5]/UART2(EN1[9])

patches.name: 0011-hw-xtensa-esp32s3_clk-UHCI0-clock-gate-and-reset-lines.patch
patches.behavior: UHCI0 port: gate level ESP32S3_GATE_UHCI0 (EN0[8]) + reset strobe/level ESP32S3_RST_UHCI0 (RST_EN0[8])

patches.name: 0012-hw-xtensa-esp32s3_clk-publish-the-0010-0011-gate-levels.patch
patches.behavior: Publishes the 0010/0011 gate levels: esp32s3_clock_update_gates now drives SPI2[6]/SPI3[16]/I2C0[7]/I2C1[18]/RMT[9]/I2S0[4]/I2S1[21]/UART0[2]/UART1[5]/UART2(EN1[9])/UHCI0[8] gate lines (0010/0011 declared the enums+bundle but still drove only the four TIMG aggregations); also fixes two wrong I2C_EXT mask names in the rst-level mapping (EXT0/EXT1 per the defs header)

patches.name: 0013-hw-xtensa-esp32s3-BBPLL-power-validity-decoupled-from.patch
patches.behavior: BBPLL power validity decoupled from the CPU mux: RTC_CNTL stores OPTIONS0 BBPLL_FORCE_PD [10]/FORCE_PU [11] (reset 0 = powered); the SoC propagates esp32s3_clk_set_pll_valid on every clock update; pll-f80m/f160m/f240m follow BBPLL power (CPU mux switches PLL->XTAL->RC_FAST->PLL keep them nominal; only FORCE_PD gates to 0 Hz); qtest regression added

patches.name: 0014-hw-xtensa-esp32s3_clk-LEDC-PCNT-MCPWM-LCD_CAM-clock-ports.patch
patches.behavior: Pulse/LCD_CAM common clock ports: gate levels ESP32S3_GATE_LEDC/PCNT/MCPWM0/MCPWM1 (EN0[11]/[10]/[17]/[20]) + ESP32S3_GATE_LCD_CAM (EN1[8]); reset strobes and periph-rst-level lines for the same bits; consumers take the existing pll-f160m/pll-f240m/xtal-clk outputs

patches.name: 0015-hw-xtensa-esp32s3-CPU1-reset-gate-runstall-lifecycle.patch
patches.behavior: TRM17.1 CTRL0 mask7/reset4 + MESSAGE reset0; cold-held CPU1/pin replay; async RESETING rising-edge CPU1-only reset; actual-ROM release and staleHALT cancellation only on combined unstall. Distinct physical cpu1-clk follows CLKgate while CPU0 stays nominal; actual nonzero CCOUNT epoch/CCOMPARE intent freezes at clock0 and resumes remaining cycles, clockenabled RUNSTALL counts/timers continue, IRQ cannot wake unclocked CPU. PerCPU mutex preserves PRE/UPDATE clock atomicity, actual HMP/GDB counts/raw inputperiod, no counterzero/frequencyalias/ROMD/pagewiden/PCspecialcase/deadlineincrease.
